noun_definition: Workspace refers to a designated area or project within the application that can be created and named by the user, which is expected to have its profile page grayed out when edited while offline.

Profile page refers to the section of the application where users can view and edit the details of their workspace, which is expected to be visually grayed out when the workspace is created offline and its name is changed.
Name refers to the identifier assigned to a workspace that is being modified in the profile page while the user is offline.
